# PARKED150_R1: parked model-cache and category expansion

This test build includes the NOTIFY150_R1 parent. It expands the parked model
candidate cache from50 to150 IDs and the25 temporary category buckets from50
to150 IDs each. It preserves the native category ordering, seed/modulo selection,
0.33-second refresh interval, traffic weights and nearby parked-car population.

The old parked cache could overwrite its count field on the51st appended ID.
That defect is reproduced by the native fixture. Whether it caused the observed
Challenger substitution must still be confirmed in this live test.

## Install and startup

1. Close the game. Preserve NOTIFY150_R1 outside the enabled plugin directory.
2. Enable only `DriverSF_V29s_160Capacity_150Request_PARKED150_R1.asi` as the
   traffic ASI. The package is staged, not installed by the agent.
3. Keep the adjusted AI file from your successful expanded-traffic test
   (`san_franciscoAI - Copy (2).fchunk` used as the active
   `san_franciscoAI.fchunk`). Start a fresh game process and load the usual save.
4. Require successful `DSFV29s_PARKED150_START revision=1 status=1 hooks=2`
   and inherited NOTIFY150/BASELINE startup records in
   `%TEMP%\DSFV29s_parked150_<PID>.log`.

All other capacities are inherited:150 requests /160 graphics slots /ED+EF,
indexed262144, resource collection131072, cleanup262144, pending512,
audio models192, global audio slots2048, shared-default audio64MiB, callback512.

## Reproduce the parked-car behavior

1. First observe parked cars after normal loading, without a manual Lua traffic
   request. Note whether the parked variety survives for several seconds.
2. At a location where you previously saw the substitution, call:

   ```lua
   ParkedVehicles.SetEnabled(false)
   ```

   Wait about2 seconds, then call:

   ```lua
   ParkedVehicles.SetEnabled(true)
   ```

3. Watch the same parking area immediately, after1 second and after5–10 seconds.
   Report whether different models remain or become Challengers. A few naturally
   selected Challengers are not by themselves a failed test.
4. Repeat the toggle a few times and visit another parking area. Category-specific
   parking placements need not choose from every loaded model.
5. Check moving traffic, engine/tire/horn audio and FPS. Return to the main menu,
   reload Story Mode and repeat the parked observation. Then exit normally.

Copy the new `DSFV29s_parked150_<PID>.log` into `dist/MAIN_150`. Report the parked
outcome before/after the delay, approximate route/sequence, FPS, audio and exit.

## Diagnostic interpretation

- `PARKED150_BUILD` records manager address, rebuild generation, exact candidate
  count/IDs and their order-sensitive hash. Category grouping can make this hash
  differ from the traffic request hash even when the same150 models are present.
- `PARKED150_STATUS` records owners/rebuilds, peak candidates and bucket demand,
  picker use, empty selections and invalid/guard counters. A150-candidate build
  is not proof that150 parked models were rendered.
  `extraSelections` counts selections beyond the original50-ID cache prefix.
- A descriptor category outside0–24, oversized candidate/bucket write, missing
  owner state or startup mismatch writes `PARKED150_FATAL` and explicitly exits
  with0x29F3. Preserve that log. No invalid copy is allowed to continue.
- Private caches persist per distinct parked-manager address until process exit;
  rebuilding the same address resets its contents. Parking-space arrays and
  nearby parked population remain native-sized and unchanged.
- The native resolver/fallback policy is unchanged. These records do not directly
  establish a selected/resolved model transition or persistent entity identity.
  Your visible result remains necessary.

Analyze a supplied log using both existing analyzers:

```powershell
python scripts/analyze_baseline150_log.py dist/MAIN_150/DSFV29s_parked150_PID.log --output analysis/parked150_PID/coverage.json
python scripts/analyze_callback_log.py dist/MAIN_150/DSFV29s_parked150_PID.log --output analysis/parked150_PID/inherited.json
```

The first tool includes parked startup/cache checks. Recorded native readiness,
body calls and audio setup returns retain their existing interpretation limits.
Full traffic snapshots/Film Director and audio return-condition decoding remain
outside this correction. Native fixture/build evidence is under
`analysis/parked150_r1_2026-11-06`.
